field_notes.vram_class: Approximate target VRAM in GB for the balanced quant at 8k context (file size + about 1.5 GB), an estimate.
field_notes.reasoning: true when the GGUF chat template exposes a thinking switch (enable_thinking).
field_notes.params_total_b: GGUF metadata parameter count in billions.
field_notes.context_max: GGUF metadata context length; nominal value, not a tested one.
field_notes.german: Only set when evidence exists (see german_source); unknown otherwise.
field_notes.author_sampler: Values from the base model card named in the source key; null when no card lists values.
field_notes.license: License tag on the HF GGUF repo; null when the repo has none.
field_notes.base: Base model line for filters: gemma / qwen / mistral (Mistral Small, Ministral) / nemo (Mistral Nemo and its upscales) / llama.
field_notes.params_active_b: Active parameters per token in billions for MoE models; null for dense ones (all parameters are active).
field_notes.rp: Roleplay quality 1-5 from public leaderboards (UGI writing score) and model cards; an estimate.
field_notes.de: German quality 1-5 (EuroEval German rank of the base model and community reports); an estimate.
field_notes.uncensored: 0 refuses adult content, 1 mostly allows it, 2 refusal-removed (UGI willingness).
field_notes.writing: Short German note on the writing style, shown in the UI.
field_notes.writing_tr: The same note in English, Spanish and Russian (en / es / ru), shown in the UI in those languages.
field_notes.confidence: How well the ratings are backed: low / mid / high.
field_notes.sources: Public pages behind the ratings: label (German), label_en (shown in every other language) + URL.
field_notes.shape: Key into shapes: the attention layout read from the GGUF header of the balanced file (block_count, attention.head_count_kv, key/value_length, sliding window and its pattern, shared_kv_layers, full_attention_interval and ssm.* for hybrids, expert_count/used). Gives the KV cache per token at any context and KV type.
field_notes.expert_share: MoE only: share of the tensor bytes in expert tensors (*_exps*) of the balanced file; what --n-cpu-moe can move to system RAM.
field_notes.shapes: full_every: every Nth layer has full attention (sliding window: the others use the window; recurrent: the others keep state_bytes of f32 state each). shared_kv_layers: the last N layers reuse earlier caches. kv_heads_per_layer: KV heads of every layer where they differ (0: a layer without attention).
field_notes.focus: What the model is made for, from its model card: general (vendor instruct model or a refusal-reduced copy of one), roleplay (character chat fine-tune or merge), story (narration), adventure (text adventure with consequences).
